issues.title: Ingest Arkansas County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $14,706,845 across 18 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($4,945,499), County Road ($3,225,060), Phillips Community College U of A One Half Percent Sales Tax ($2,600,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Prosecuting Attorney (County General Fund)
issues.detail: Printed total is $171,964.00; the categories listed add to $171,944.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
